0.name: TEXT_REGYOK6GOLMAJIIKGROVE_00878_HAPOLLJA_000_000
0.description: I have nothing to say to outsiders.

1.name: TEXT_REGYOK6GOLMAJIIKGROVE_00878_HAPOLLJA_000_010
1.description: Yes? Come to inquire about najool, have you?

4.name: TEXT_REGYOK6GOLMAJIIKGROVE_00878_A1_000_002
4.description: What kind of place is this?

6.name: TEXT_REGYOK6GOLMAJIIKGROVE_00878_HAPOLLJA_000_020
6.description: I am but a humble grove worker. Though najool─Ja Tiika bananas, as you call them─may have an unusual appearance, they are actually quite sweet.

7.name: TEXT_REGYOK6GOLMAJIIKGROVE_00878_HAPOLLJA_000_021
7.description: I have proposed various uses for the glowing peels, such as employing them to cure animal skins, or adding them to medicines. Unfortunately, my ideas are not very popular...

8.name: TEXT_REGYOK6GOLMAJIIKGROVE_00878_HAPOLLJA_000_030
8.description: This is Golmajiik Grove, where we cultivate najool. As you can see, it is one of the brighter, more open locations in Mamook.

9.name: TEXT_REGYOK6GOLMAJIIKGROVE_00878_HAPOLLJA_000_031
9.description: The fruit is primarily consumed by our own people, but the leaves...w-well, outsiders are known to use them as well. I'm afraid I can say no more on the matter. Trade secrets, and all.

10.name: TEXT_REGYOK6GOLMAJIIKGROVE_00878_HAPOLLJA_000_040
10.description: To think we could grow other crops here... Nevertheless, I intend to remain a najool farmer, as I always have. They are a precious part of our culture, after all.

11.name: TEXT_REGYOK6GOLMAJIIKGROVE_00878_HAPOLLJA_000_050
11.description: Blessed siblings no longer stand in the highest position of power. I know this, and yet the truth has not fully sunk in. But perhaps this forest will succeed in changing after all...
